# RevvMotiv

> Precision Automotive Aero & Carbon Fiber Styling Components for Drivers Across India.

RevvMotiv designs, manufactures, and ships 1:1 OEM-fitment carbon fiber aero splitters, diffusers, spoilers, custom permanent tyre lettering, and performance lighting accessories across India.

## Key Sections & Pages

- [Home](https://revvmotiv.com/): Featured builds, catalog categories, video showcase, and customer reviews.
- [Shop Catalog](https://revvmotiv.com/shop): Complete store catalog for styling and aerodynamic parts.
- [Our Work Showcase](https://revvmotiv.com/work): Real customer workshop builds documented across angle views (Hyundai Verna, Maruti Swift, Hyundai i20 N Line, Volkswagen Polo GT).
- [FAQ & Knowledge Base](https://revvmotiv.com/faq): Factual Q&As on vehicle fitment verification, material differences (Carbon vs ABS), shipping times, and COD payments.
- [About Us](https://revvmotiv.com/about): Our garage story, material standards (Pre-preg carbon, ABS polymer), and fitting facility in Greater Noida.
- [Contact & Support](https://revvmotiv.com/contact): Customer technician support, WhatsApp booking, and fitment enquiries.

## Primary Product Categories

- **Front Splitters & Lips**: 2x2 twill carbon fiber front splitters, ABS chin spoilers, and V-style bumper lips.
- **Rear Diffusers**: Quad-fin and dual-exit bumper diffusers engineered for specific chassis lines.
- **Spoilers & Wings**: GT-style rear wings, carbon trunk lip spoilers, and hatchback roof extensions.
- **Side Skirt Extensions**: Aerodynamic rocker panel extensions in carbon fiber and gloss black ABS.
- **Tyre Stickers**: 3D raised rubber permanent lettering kits with bonding adhesive.
- **Lighting & Utilities**: Smoked OLED sequential tail lights, LED DRL assemblies, and mirror turn signals.
